title: Any Large Language Model Can Be a Reliable Judge: Debiasing with a Reasoning-based Bias Detector
reasoning: The paper focuses on mitigating structural biases in LLM evaluation (verbosity, position, bandwagon, and sentiment) rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical frameworks. While it mentions social biases as a future research direction in the limitations section, it is not a core component of the current study.
